en:
That sounds kinda gross, Tana.
Though... I'm glad to hear you're back.

All right! Now that I'm joining up with you guys,
I've gotta make sure you know how I feel!
Everyone in the Kiryu Clan!
What's with this guy?
Sorry. This is more like how Tana usually is.

Hmph. I guess if nothing else, he'll bring
a little bit of cheer to our side.

Kiryu-san. I'm going to save Okada,
no matter what.
He's... a close friend, after all.

Please lend me your strength,
at least until then.

Of course. If it means keeping your
friendship alive, I'll do whatever it takes.

Oh, such a pretty little lady!
I love you!
Huh!? Who the heck is this guy!?

The only ones left in Kamurocho
at this point are Okada and Komei.

There are still some JUSTIS guys down in Onomichi,
though. Let's focus on getting rid of them first.

Next time you head back down there,
we'll be following right behind you.

When you have the chance,
stop by the hideout in Onomichi.
Who the heck are<symbol=em_dash_with_outline>
Masao!

How lovely it is to see you, Kiryu Clan.
We appreciate the welcome party, truly.
Been a while, Joe.

Okada. Can we go somewhere else?
I want to talk to you in private.

What a brazen fool you are.
Rainmaker has no need to speak to you!

Now then, we are not here to
trade idle barbs with you buffoons.
We've come to deliver your final warning.
Final warning?

Indeed. The stage is set for the ultimate battle
between you miscreants and the forces of JUSTIS.

To be honest, I didn't expect Joe and a washed-up
yakuza would ever manage to make it this far.

But your glory days are coming to an end.
JUSTIS will bring the curtain down on your lives.

While you have focused on expanding influence,
we instead chose to solidify our core.
We are stronger now than we've ever been before.

Furthermore, all that strength is concentrated in
Kamurocho. You have no hope of victory.

We are on a far higher level than you rats!
Do you understand!?
We'll never know if that's true unless we fight.

How can you even begin to think that!?
That's why you're nothing but a fool!

The only foolish thing possible would be
giving up without even trying to win.
Kazuma Kiryu... This is all your fault.

Joe coming back. The Six Lunatics failing me.
You are to blame for every last thing.

The way you cling to your beliefs
so tightly... It makes me sick.

This next battle will be when the Kiryu Clan
draws its final breath. I hope you're ready.
Hey, Okada.

What is it?
Dragon of Dojima, Kazuma Kiryu-san...

You already know the truth, don't you?
What you're doing is wrong.

I don't get it.
What's your angle?
Would you ask me this?
Kazuma Kiryu-san...
I have no angle.

The final battle between JUSTIS and the Kiryu Clan
is fast approaching. Let's settle this, once and for all.
Oh, I almost forgot. Joe, Kiryu-san.
Don't forget to bring your umbrellas.

You heard me. I'm going to
make it rain here in Kamurocho.
Not with money... but with blood.
After all, I'm the Rainmaker.

So this is really the final battle.
Guess we're gonna end this for good.

Sounds like it's gonna be epic.
Can't wait to bust some skulls.

I've been feelin' outta shape lately, too.
But that's gonna change now. Let's do this shit!

Come on, you guys.
Tranquilo! Chill out!

This is gonna be the end. We don't need to rush,
so just make sure you're ready first.

Eh, we don't gotta worry about those weirdos.
There's a real genius among our ranks.
Me, I mean.

All right, I'm feeling real good about this!
Let's get pumped up together, for old time's sake!
The hell? Why didn't anyone do it!?
Who'd do that stupid shit?
No way that's ever gonna catch on, man.
You guys are brutal...
Okada. We're gonna wake you up for sure!
Joe. It's almost time.

Yeah. It's only because of you that
we've come this far, Kiryu-san.
This will be the final battle.

All right, everyone. It's time for our showdown
with JUSTIS. Are you all ready?

Course we are! We've come this far,
so we're totally gonna win!
Do you have anything to say, Joe?

I never expected we'd actually be able to go
toe-to-toe with a powerful enemy like JUSTIS.
We're only here because of all of you.

And because of Kiryu-san, who took it upon
himself to knock me back into shape.

As one of JUSTIS's founders, I have to
take responsibility. I'll destroy them!

Now, this is our last fight. Please lend me
your strength, just a little longer!
We're gonna give 'em all we got!
Hell yeah! Let's crush these shits, Koji!
Damn straight!
Come on, Kiryu-san!
Okay. Kiryu Clan... Move out!
Si!
Good to see you, my Kiryu Clan friends.

I expected you all to run far, far away, but
it seems your stupidity has gotten the best of you.

Now then... It's almost time to bring Kiryu Clan
blood raining down on the streets of Kamurocho.

Is there anything you'd like to say
before we begin, Rainmaker?
Nah... I'm good.

Just as I would have thought. 
Are you ready, Kiryu Clan? It's time to die!

I-Impossible! Our military strength should
have overwhelmed them easily... Why!?

There's more to a team than just
how many members you have.

You have to like them, trust them,
form bonds with them.

If you do that, one plus one will be more than two.
It'll reach one or two hundred.

Your inability to see the value in that
is why you lost here today.
Y-Yes?
Come here.
Huh? A-Are you sure that's what you want?
Yes. It's up to you now.
Joe. Kiryu-san.
You two are something special.

I sold my soul to the devil for JUSTIS,
but you still managed to stop me.

And... you did it with true justice
by your side. I envy that.

However, I have my own way of doing things.
It's not time to surrender to you yet.

Kazuchika. Tana told me about
everything that happened to you.

I'm sorry I wasn't there to help.
I wish I had realized sooner.

But no matter what happened, resorting to
the same shit the colors did isn't right!

Let's start fresh, Kazuchika! JUSTIS can work
for the good of Kamurocho, like it did before!
Are you finished?
Joe. There's something I still need to do.

And in order to do it...
I need to defeat you.

This is my last stand.
Try to stop me, Kiryu Clan.

If you really think you can defeat
Rainmaker, come on and fight me!
Fine, then.

It looks like talking isn't going to get us anywhere.
We'll have to let our fists show him how we feel.
Kiryu-san. Let's take them down.

No need to tell me twice.
I've never turned down a fight in my life.
Bring it on, Kazuchika!
I've lost, Joe.

In all the fights we've had,
this is the first time I've won.
Is it, now?
Losers tend to remember their losses, you know?

I see... I suppose I'll always 
remember this day, then.
Hey, Kazuchika. JUSTIS is finished.

So I'm going to ask you again.
Let's start over, together.

We can fight with justice on our side.
You down?
No, not yet.

There's still something I need to do.
It's almost time.

You really think JUSTIS is finished?
That's quite a foolish thing to say, Joe!
Komei!
From now on, I'm in charge.

Don't you see?
The era of Rainmaker is over.

As the leader of JUSTIS, I will rule over
Kamurocho with the city's gangs at my feet!

What are you taking about?
There's nobody left in JUSTIS!

Oh, I suppose I did say we used all our forces.
That was nothing but a lie, though.

In truth, I've been buying the loyalty of
JUSTIS's members with the help of a wealthy patron.
Buying them?

Yes. Our organization consists of countless youths
who only came onboard after being charmed by Okada.

But after slipping them a little bit of cash,
it was simple getting them to join my cause instead.

The ones you've beaten so far are only those
who refused me and stayed loyal to Okada.

A large portion of the team has betrayed Okada.
Their allegiance now rests with me.

JUSTIS isn't over yet. If anything, we're only
now beginning as a new organization.
You bastard.

What about that wealthy patron
you were talking about? Who is he?

As for that wealthy patron of mine,
allow me to introduce him to you.
Please step over here, Satsuki-san.
Long time no see, Okada.
Kazuchika... Who is this guy?

He's the one who tortured me. And the one
who assaulted my girlfriend.

Guess I went a bit overboard back then.
I feel bad. Hurts the heart, you know?

Although, that pain's what pushed you to
turn JUSTIS into what it is today.
If anything, you should be thanking me.

Although... I'll be taking back JUSTIS
now, if you don't mind.
What a sad end for you, Rainmaker.

I will take control of JUSTIS and
serve together with Satsuki-san.

Satsuki-san has a great many connections with
the yakuza and mafia organizations of this town.

As long as I have his backing, JUSTIS will grow
to be the strongest gang in all of Japan.
Komei... Has this been your plan all along?

That's right. The only reason I joined JUSTIS
to begin with was to eventually lay claim to it.

I wanted to use Okada to make JUSTIS bigger,
then snatch it away from him once it got there.

Then by using JUSTIS, I was going to
get rich beyond your wildest imagination.
That was our plan.

Though... I didn't even have to take it from him.
Okada handed me the reins willingly.
What? So when he whispered in your ear...

You proved a vital asset to my plan, Okada. Things
would have been far tougher without your trust.

Your ignorance to my traitorous nature gave me the
time I needed to plan this coup. I truly appreciate it.

You're dumb, though. By not figuring out what was
going on, you only propped up my plot.

You may have charisma, but you clearly
lack the leadership skills to match.

Such a shame, Rainmaker!
The only rain that will be falling today is your tears!

What's wrong?
Has my brilliance driven you mad?
You two are the ones who have been tricked.

Everything I've done to make JUSTIS what it is now...
It was all to draw you out, Satsuki.

I couldn't forgive you for what you did to me.
I've always vowed to get my revenge.

But those who live in the shadows are hard to
track down. I couldn't begin to get a read on you.

I had to figure out a way to lure you into the open.
That was how I developed this plan.

To start, I knew you had an affinity for violent
gangs like the way the colors were before us.
So, if I made another gang similar to them...
...You'd come crawling back out of your hole.

I'm surprised you actually fell for it, though.
You're not as clever as I thought.
I didn't make JUSTIS for the money or the power.
It was all so I could get my revenge on you.
Huh. So that was your plan, Kazuchika...

S-So then, you already knew I was working
with Satsuki-san behind your back...?

Exactly. He knew, and still chose
to let you do your thing.

Kazuchika clearly knew everything you were up
to, including what you were doing with Satsuki.
Right. I suspected every detail.

Then why... Why did you say you'd
hand me the reins of JUSTIS?

Don't you understand, Komei?
You're just a pawn for Satsuki.

If you didn't have control off the group,
he'd just cut you off and stay in hiding.

So that's why... It was so Satsuki-san
would keep supporting me...

That's probably it. It would've been a real pain
if Satsuki got away when we were so close.

As long as you had control of JUSTIS,
Kazuchika's plan was still in motion.

Instead of gaining any real power though,
you just led us straight to your leader.

You may be the best strategist around, but
you clearly don't have the leadership to match.
Damn you!

I don't care about any of this bullshit, as long as
I have obedient soldiers working under me.
Kiryu-san... You head up the Kiryu Clan, yes?
Yeah, that's right.
How about you come work for me?

This fool Komei couldn't manage JUSTIS if his life
depended on it. Your team is much more promising.

As long as you promise obedience...
You'll find the compensation to your liking. Well?
You really expect me to agree to that?
Yeah, I guess you're right.

As expected of the Dragon of Dojima, Kazuma Kiryu.
I apologize for the foolish question.

In that case, JUSTIS will have the honor of working
with me. Together we'll eliminate the Kiryu Clan.

And once we do, we'll make sure every suitable
young person in Kamurocho joins the JUSTIS cause.

They'll become our infantry squad,
carrying out crimes that rake in the cash.

And if any of them get caught, they'll take the fall
for me. I'll go back to my shadows.

There's no way...
We won't let that happen!
Try to stop me, if you can.

Immature little punk.
You shouldn't look down at your elders.
